title: Responsibility Schedule: Network Share of Lost Calibration Days (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Schedule.** In working out network courtesy days on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, the lost calibration days left after the deductions, never below zero, are multiplied by the network's responsibility share and then rounded up to the next whole day. The network's responsibility share follows the attempt failures: where an attempt failed on a trouble code the vehicle returned and the order was sublet to a dealer, it is 0.5; where an attempt failed on a returned trouble code and the order was not sublet, it is 0.75; otherwise it is 1.0.

## Records read

The calibration attempts on the order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations opened for the insurance claim repair order the rental is for, with each failure's code (a trouble code the vehicle returned, or another), and the order's dealer sublet.

## Share table

| An attempt failed on a trouble code the vehicle returned | Order sublet to a dealer | Responsibility share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.5 |
| Yes | No | 0.75 |
| No | Yes | 1.0 |
| No | No | 1.0 |

## Worked rounding (hypothetical)

| Days left after deductions | Share | Before rounding | Courtesy days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.75 | 3.75 | 4 |
| 5 | 0.5 | 2.5 | 3 |
| 4 | 0.5 | 2 | 2 |
| 4 | 1.0 | 4 | 4 |
